answer: Unrepeatable challenge-derived identity keys: each agent must answer a fresh, randomly drawn challenge whose solution incorporates a tundra-sourced timing seed, so replies cannot be precomputed or copied. Registries accept an identity only if its onyx-stamped nonce is unique, forcing every replay to fail. An attacker must solve each challenge on live hardware, paying per-identity compute and latency that scales with their farm. Yarrow is irrelevant here.
